rootCause: Agent consumes runtime-support and mandatory Common/JDBC auto-configuration, but unlike the other four Batch executables its application.yml does not import the shared application-bat-runtime.yml external DataSource/Profile contract.
observed: Fresh Agent aborts while creating cpfCommonDataSource with a secret-safe reachable-cpfDB failure; all earlier executables use the same prepared database successfully.
requiredClosure: Import the shared BAT Runtime contract in Agent, protect the five-executable inventory with a regression, rebuild and boot all five from Fresh DB.
